categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies CI workflow definitions by removing the requirement for a privileged container in the ASan CI job.
categories.rationale: Removes privileged container requirements in CI and simplifies test infrastructure. According to the author, running USDT tests without BCC or kernel headers enables the 'ASan CI job no longer [to need] a privileged container and uses SYS_PTRACE instead', reducing CI complexity and local test friction.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Modifies test harness scripts and CI workflows rather than user-facing or developer scripts in contrib; test helpers are classified under tests, not tools.
categories.rationale: Does not touch standalone tools or contrib developer utilities, affecting only functional test harness scripts and CI definitions.
